Q: get path to .git/ directory, including from a worktree A:

If you're in a worktree, you can get the path to the repository's .git directory using the command git rev-parse with the option --git-common-dir (although the docs don't provide an in-depth and clear description for it).

git rev-parse --git-common-dir

Unlike the flag --git-dir, which returns the Git directory used by the current worktree, --git-common-dir returns the common Git directory shared by all worktrees.

Q: Celery: What is the best way to stagger job execution by a few minutes? A:

This was a long time ago, but hey i found it, so here you are:

chunks = list(itertools.batched(items, chunk_size, strict=False))
# Schedule chunks with progressive delay
for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks):
    my_task.si(items=list(chunk)).set(countdown=i * stagger_seconds).delay()
